🚀 SketchForge-3D | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Quickly designing and exporting 3D models for various purposes, such as 3D printing or prototyping, directly within a web browser without complex setup.
✨ Key Features: • Local-first projects stored in browser storage • Real 3D workplane with camera and snap controls • Primitive shape library (boxes, cylinders, spheres, etc.) • Solid and hole workflow for boolean operations • Boolean Intersection
📖 Summary: SketchForge-3D is a local-first, browser-based 3D design editor that allows users to build, modify, import, and export 3D models directly in their web browser. It focuses on a streamlined workflow for creating parts without requiring accounts or heavy software installations.
